summary: A French newspaper report on ether drinking in 19th-century Paris and Britain, describing the habit as a form of intoxication sought for visions and dreamlike sensations, especially among women. It also reports Ernest Hart’s warning about the spread of ether drinking in northern Ireland and parts of England; a substantive account of the practice and its social framing.
